cell_type_context: Rat primary oligodendrocyte cultures and oligodendrocyte progenitors for NT-3/TrkC/PLCgamma and CREB/BCL2 studies; complementary mammalian TrkC receptor-expression systems
compartment_context: extracellular NT-3; plasma-membrane NTRK3/TrkC; receptor-proximal PLCgamma1; nuclear CREB and BCL2 promoter
injury_context: no SCI transfer inferred; oligodendrocyte comparator models only
context_scope: Composite primary evidence links NT-3-responsive TrkC to PLCgamma1 signaling and independently links NT-3-responsive CREB to direct BCL2 promoter regulation in oligodendrocyte progenitors
assay_or_perturbation: NT-3 stimulation; TrkC expression and receptor autophosphorylation; PLCgamma1 phosphorylation; MAPK/PKC inhibition; CREB knockdown or inhibition; BCL2 promoter CRE mutation and protein-DNA binding assays
citation_note: Primary studies support NT-3/TrkC-associated PLCgamma1 signaling and NT-3/CREB-dependent BCL2 promoter regulation in oligodendroglial systems
evidence_summary: Composite primary-supported claim: NT-3 activates functional TrkC-associated PLCgamma1 signaling in oligodendroglial systems, while independent NT-3 studies show CREB activation and CREB-dependent direct BCL2 promoter regulation. This supplies a bounded NT-3-TrkC-PLCG1/CREB-BCL2 evidence route.
limitations: The receptor-proximal TrkC/PLCgamma1 evidence and the CREB/BCL2 promoter evidence are complementary studies rather than one single end-to-end perturbation. The PLCgamma1-to-CREB connector is therefore retained as a plausible evidence-layer continuation, not a newly asserted graph edge; no SCI transfer, causal graph traversal or database confidence score is asserted.
